svg.title: Open-loop climbing versus closed-loop climbing
svg.desc: An open-loop climber proceeds toward a fog-obscured goal without checkpoints or a safety line: no feedback, no recovery, and blind commitment. A closed-loop climber follows individual tasks and milestones toward a visible goal. Tests and adjustments form a feedback loop. Anchors and a belayer illustrate rollback to checkpoints, pausing and resuming, and informed decisions.
